author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
ATP:guanido phosphotransferase IPR000749

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel arginine kinase, Argk1 (FBgn0000116)

* **Description of issue**
The entry description says "ATP:guanido phosphotransferases are a family of structurally and functionally related enzymes [[1, ](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/InterPro/IPR000749/#PUB00002616)[2](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/InterPro/IPR000749/#PUB00000670)] that reversibly catalyse the transfer of phosphate between ATP and various phosphogens."
And then lists 5 different activities that are included, only one of which is creatine kinase.

But then the entry is annotated with the single GO MF "[creatine kinase activity (GO:0004111)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/GTerm?id=GO:0004111)"

So this either needs replacing with a common parent (GO:0016775 phosphotransferase activity, nitrogenous group as acceptor) or removing.
title: InterPro2GO issue: ATP:guanido phosphotransferase IPR000749

author: tony787
body:
Hi Steven, 
I have removed the term and replaced it with GO:0016775 - phosphotransferase activity, nitrogenous group as acceptor. 
Changes will be visible in the next InterPro release.
Best wishes,
Toni
